758:t_1:753.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Well... if you dive into the sea in $$チェインバー#robot$$, the $$クジライカ$$ will be on guard, after all.」

758:t_1:754.en:
$$レド$$
「I found a trick for not making them wary. If I read their signs of anger, I can act so as not to provoke them.」

758:t_1:755.en:
$$レド$$
「If the research advances, someday it may even become possible to communicate with them.」

758:t_1:757.en:
$$レド$$
「This too is thanks to $$エイミー$$ and everyone in this fleet teaching me important things.」

758:t_1:758.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Coexistence and co-prosperity. That is a truth of the universe.」

758:t_1:759.en:
$$レド$$
「Someday, I want to tell the $$人類銀河同盟$$ about this fact, too.」

758:t_1:760.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Are you going back to space?」

758:t_1:761.en:
$$レド$$
「No. The place I'm going back to is this $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

758:t_1:763.en:
$$レド$$
「If I ever end up going to the Alliance, $$エイミー$$... I want to take you with me then.」

758:t_1:765.en:
$$レド$$
「Yeah... I want you to see the place where I was born.」

758:t_1:766.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Okay, $$レド$$. When that time comes, let's go together.」

758:t_1:767.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In that event, this unit will serve as your guide.」

758:t_1:768.en:
$$レド$$
「Of course, you're coming along too.」

758:t_1:769.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. In due course, this unit will also consider navigation within each parallel world.」

758:t_1:770.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In order to reunite with them.」

758:t_1:771.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm still going to rely on you, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

758:t_1:772.en:
$$レド$$
(That's right. I'm going to live on with $$エイミー$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$... with all my comrades.)

758:t_1:773.en:
$$レド$$
(This verdant planet... and this new world are the place where I and the people dear to me will live.)

758:t_1:780.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's a little out of season, but...」

758:t_1:781.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「starting now, I'm paying out our very first bonus!」

758:t_1:782.en:
$$木下$$
「Y-you mean our company is finally getting a bonus!」

758:t_1:784.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aw, don't, $$郁絵$$-chan! This is the result of everyone at the company working hard up to today!」

758:t_1:786.en:
$$厚井$$
「What's wrong, Executive Director? Aren't you happy about the bonus?」

758:t_1:787.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Of course I'm happy, but... if this ends up tipping the business into trouble, I worry the bonus will turn into severance pay...」

758:t_1:788.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It'll be fine. In the hyperdimensional world, parallel worlds stretch out beyond the Gate, you know.」

758:t_1:789.en:
$$郁絵$$
「In other words, there are infinitely many places to find work.」

758:t_1:790.en:
$$木下$$
「I'll give it my all! I'm going to become a Gate traveler and go out drumming up business!」

758:t_1:791.en:
$$厚井$$
「Oh... the bonus has the Section Chief all fired up.」

758:t_1:792.en:
$$柿小路$$
「With my subordinate hustling this hard, it won't do for me, his boss, to be the one worrying.」

758:t_1:793.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Exactly, Executive Director. Besides, tomorrow I...」

758:t_1:794.en:
$$加代$$
「$$ワッ太$$... Miss $$美重子$$ and Mr. $$大門$$ are here.」

758:t_1:795.en:
$$大門$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$! Good to see you looking well.」

758:t_1:796.en:
$$美重子$$
「Tomorrow... I came to make sure you haven't forgotten.」

758:t_1:797.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry! It's the graduation ceremony I've been waiting and waiting for, after all!」

758:t_1:798.en:
$$厚井$$
「I see... Tomorrow is the elementary school graduation.」

758:t_1:799.en:
$$木下$$
「So that means you'll no longer be an elementary school president.」

758:t_1:800.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「To make up for it, I'll be a little more grown up and work harder than ever!」

758:t_1:801.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Then that's the end of calling you the Young President, isn't it?」

758:t_1:802.en:
$$厚井$$
「That's right. You're already a full-fledged, proper president.」

758:t_1:803.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've still got a long way to go.」

758:t_1:804.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Only when the Executive Director no longer worries about bankruptcy, and we can properly pay bonuses every summer and winter, will I be able to hold my head up as a president.」

758:t_1:805.en:
$$木下$$
「Well said! Let's celebrate the President's new start by going all out - really cut loose!」

758:t_1:806.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Then, everyone, let's give the President a cheer!」

758:t_1:807.en:
$$厚井$$
「This is the last time for this cheer, so let's give it everything we've got.」

758:t_1:808.en:
$$木下$$
「Come on... ma'am, the teachers, and $$梅本$$, join in together with us!」

758:t_1:810.en:
$$梅本$$
($$竹尾$$... Your son is growing up strong, along with our $$トライダー$$, yours and mine.)

758:t_1:811.en:
$$柿小路$$
「All right, everyone... here we go!」

758:t_1:815.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(Me... together with everyone and $$トライダー$$, I'll work hard and make $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ the number one company in the hyperdimensional world!)

758:t_1:816.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(And then, I'll go see $$勝平$$ and everyone! Like, 'This is the hyperdimensional world's jack-of-all-trades!')

758:t_1:820.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...So you're coming to Earth next month, right?」

758:t_1:821.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's a good opportunity. I'm thinking of trying out this thing called junior high school myself.」

758:t_1:822.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Dr. $$敷島$$ said he'll be your guardian. I'm looking forward to seeing you again, $$グーラ$$.」

758:t_1:823.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Me too. Well then, until we meet again...」

758:t_1:824.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The fighting is over now... So $$グーラ$$ can live together with us.」

758:t_1:825.en:
$$マッキー$$
「But you're going to keep working as a special investigator for the $$ＩＣＰＯ$$, aren't you, $$正太郎$$?」

758:t_1:826.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Even if there are no more space-scale battles, criminals will keep showing up.」

758:t_1:827.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I intend for $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ to keep fighting those villains, same as always.」

758:t_1:829.en:
$$敷島$$
「Don't be selfish, $$牧子$$. $$正太郎$$ decided on his own way of living for himself.」

758:t_1:833.en:
$$大塚$$
「We've received a report that a group that appears to be remnants of the Robot Mafia is hiding on a deserted island. I'm asking you to deploy.」

758:t_1:834.en:
$$マッキー$$
「Please wait, Director! $$正太郎$$'s elementary school graduation ceremony is tomorrow!」

758:t_1:835.en:
$$大塚$$
「I-I see... In that case, it's impossible.」

758:t_1:838.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$マッキー$$. I'll be right back.」
